steps.description: Stream bounded evidence into isolated quarantine and seal with SHA-256 digest
Append sequential attributable custody events and record signed external checkpoint
Index normalized timeline events and execute bounded search within scan caps
Package self-contained portable bundle and verify offline without server
Restore case consistency and rebuild derived index without custody rewrite
